claims.label: PROVED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
claims.exact_statement: For all integers a,b>=2, let q_n be +1 only at the origin, let R_(a,b) be the complete L+Q selector packet of q_a q_b against constant +1, and D_n the packet of q_n against its matching constant. If Xi_(a,b)=R_(a,b)-D_a-D_b and Gamma_(m|b)=R_(m,b)-(R_(m-1,b)+D_b)/2 with R_(0,b)=D_b, then sum_(m=1)^a 2^(m-a) Gamma_(m|b)=D_a+Xi_(a,b), and R_(a,b)+N_(a|b)=D_b+P_(a|b), with each reached credit and terminal packet used once. The reverse order holds with a,b exchanged. Xi has no fixed sign, with Xi_(4,4)<-0.01038, Xi_(5,5)>0.00239, and Xi_(n,n)=4^-n(4n-24+6/ln2)+O(n 8^-n).
hypotheses: disjoint variables for q_a and q_b
complete conditional-label plus phase packet L+Q
does_not_depend_on: the all-dimension sign of the q_n full L+Q credit
refutes: Exact additivity R_(a,b)=D_a+D_b for all point-defect factors
Any two-factor ledger that ignores the cross term Xi_(a,b)
does_not_prove: a terminal packet bound by total influence for arbitrary Boolean functions
a many-factor or shared-variable refund theorem
claims.first_unproved_line: Assign every higher-order interaction in a many-factor or arbitrary branching tree to a unique first-revelation node and bound the resulting positive credits plus terminals by nonreused influence.
